sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Jumpy Robot lies its core gameplay mechanics, which revolve around controlling the robot as it navigates through increasingly difficult levels. The game requires players to tap left and right to control the robot, which will jump when the player taps the screen or clicks the mouse button.

The robot's movement is physics-based, meaning that the distance it travels and the height it reaches depend on the force and timing of the jump. Players must carefully plan and execute their jumps to ensure the robot lands safely on the platforms. This requires a combination of precision and strategy, making the game challenging but rewarding.

One of the most critical elements of the game is the jump mechanic. The robot's jump is not a simple tap-and-go affair, but rather a complex process that depends on the timing and force of the jump. Players must carefully time their jumps to ensure the robot reaches the next platform safely.
